subject.title: fix(tui): guarantee exit after a drained/hung gateway teardown

question: Does the current forced-push head cancel the teardown watchdog after a clean standalone `runTui()` return while retaining it for a genuinely hung drained-session teardown?
rationale: The only concrete finding targets an earlier reviewed revision, and the protected maintainer label plus unavailable current-head inspection prevent a safe automated verdict.

options.title: Verify current-head shutdown semantics
options.body: Confirm the clean-return cancellation and retain the bounded forced exit only for teardown that has not returned.

options.title: Revise the shutdown ownership
options.body: If the timer cannot be safely cancelled at the CLI return boundary, move ownership so normal and hung paths have distinct, testable deadlines.

recommendation.title: Verify current-head shutdown semantics
recommendation.body: Confirm the clean-return cancellation and retain the bounded forced exit only for teardown that has not returned.
